L00001: # PyCodeGPT
L00002: A pre-trained GPT model for Python code completion and generation
L00003: 
L00004: ## What is it?
L00005: 
L00006: PyCodeGPT is efficient and effective GPT-Neo-based model for python code generation task, which is similar to [OpenAI Codex](https://openai.com/blog/openai-codex/), [Github Copliot](https://copilot.github.com/), [CodeParrot](https://huggingface.co/blog/codeparrot), [AlphaCode](https://deepmind.com/blog/article/Competitive-programming-with-AlphaCode).
L00007: 
L00008: ## Training Data
L00009: Due to the small size of public released dataset, we proposed to collect data from GitHub from scratch. We first crawled 1.2M python-related repositories hosted by GitHub. Then, we used these repository URLs to download all contents of each repository from GitHub. After that, we got 60M raw python files under 1MB with a total size of 330GB. Finally, we carefully designed various strategies of data cleaning to get about 96GB data for training. Please refer to the following table for the details.
L00010: 
L00011: |Model|Repositories|Size and file after filtering|
L00012: |:------:|:---:|:---:|
L00013: | CodeParrot | 0.56M | 12GB (compressed), 5.4M |
L00014: | Codex | 54M | 159GB |
L00015: | PyCodeGPT | 1.2M | 96GB, 13M |
L00016: 
L00017: 
L00018: ## Pretrained models
L00019: 
L00020: we aims to train median-large pre-trained models (model size with 110M) based on GPT-Neo:
L00021: - PyCodeGPT-110M: derived from GPT-Neo 125M with a vocabulary size of 32K.
L00022: 
L00023: PyCodeGPT-110M is available on [HuggingFace](https://huggingface.co/Daoguang/PyCodeGPT).
L00024: 
L00025: ## Evaluation
L00026: 1. Install requirements (python 3.7)
L00027: ```bash
L00028: $ pip install -r requirements.txt
L00029: ```
L00030: 
L00031: 2. Install [HumanEval](https://github.com/openai/human-eval)
L00032: - Note that you can successfully evaluate your model after uncommenting 58th line of `human-eval/human_eval/execution.py`
L00033: ```bash
L00034: $ git clone https://github.com/openai/human-eval
L00035: $ pip install -e human-eval
L00036: ```
L00037: 
L00038: 3. Run `eval_human_eval.py` to generate programs
L00039:     - Arguments
L00040:         - `model_name_or_path` : Path to the model checkpoint to be evaluated. 
L00041:         - `output_dir` : Path to save generated programs
L00042:         - `num_completions` : The number of program to be generated
L00043:         - `temperature` : Temperature for sampling
L00044:         - `top_p` : p value for nucleus sampling
L00045:         - `max_new_tokens` : Maximum number of generated token
L00046:     - Example usage
L00047:         
L00048:         ```bash
L00049:         $ python eval_human_eval.py \
L00050:         	--model_name_or_path PyCodeGPT-110M/ \
L00051:         	--output_dir results/ \
L00052:         	--num_completions 100 \
L00053:         	--temperature 0.2 \
L00054:         	--top_p 0.95 \
L00055:         	--max_new_tokens 100 \
L00056:         	--gpu_device 0
L00057:         ```
L00058: 
L00059: 4. Evaluate functional correctness
L00060:    ```bash
L00061:    $ evaluate_functional_correctness <samples_path>
L00062:    # Example
L00063:    $ evaluate_functional_correctness results/human_eval.t0.2.p0.95.l100.n100.samples.jsonl
L00064:    ```
L00065: 
L00066: Here's our evaluation result on HumanEval dataset:

L00068: Note: our model can have a comparable accuracy with Codex of similar model size.

L00015: def extract_first_block(string):
L00016:     return re.split('\nclass |\ndef |\n#|\nif |\nprint', string)[0].rstrip()
L00017: 
L00018: def remove_samples_in_comments(prompt: str) -> str:
L00019:     prompt = prompt.replace('\n', '#N#')
L00020:     p = re.compile(r'(#N#)+    (>>>|Example).*"""')
L00021:     return p.sub('\n    """', prompt).replace('#N#', '\n')
L00022: 
L00023: temperature = 0.2
L00024: max_length = 50
L00025: do_normalize = True
L00026: remove_examples = False

L00028: def generate_code(model: GPTNeoForCausalLM, tokenizer: RobertaTokenizer, text: str, num_generated=10):
L00029: 
L00030:     #text = text.lstrip('\n')
L00031:     if remove_examples:
L00032:         text = remove_samples_in_comments(text)
L00033: 
L00034:     text = text.replace("    ", '\t') if do_normalize else text
L00035: 
L00036:     input_ids = tokenizer(text, return_tensors="pt").input_ids
L00037:     input_ids = input_ids.to(device)
L00038:     beam_outputs = model.generate(
L00039:         input_ids,
L00040:         do_sample=True,
L00041:         # num_beams=5, # default is 1 or comment this line to not use beam search
L00042:         no_repeat_ngram_size=8,
L00043:         temperature=temperature,
L00044:         pad_token_id=tokenizer.eos_token_id,
L00045:         eos_token_id=tokenizer.eos_token_id,
L00046:         max_length = max_length + input_ids.size(1),
L00047:         top_p=0.9,
L00048:         num_return_sequences=num_generated
L00049:     )
L00050: 
L00051:     gen_results, results_set = [], set([])
L00052:     for _, beam_output in enumerate(beam_outputs):
L00053:         gen_output = beam_output[input_ids.size(1):]
L00054:         gen_text = tokenizer.decode(gen_output, skip_special_tokens=True)
L00055:         gen_text = extract_first_block(gen_text)
L00056: 
L00057:         if do_normalize:
L00058:             gen_text = gen_text.replace('\t', '    ')
L00059: 
L00060:         gen_results.append(gen_text)
L00061:         results_set.add(gen_text)
L00062: 
L00063:     return gen_results
L00064: 
L00065: def load_generation_pipe(model_name_or_path: str, model_type='gpt-neo'):
L00066:     if model_type == 'gpt-neo':
L00067:         model = GPTNeoForCausalLM.from_pretrained(model_name_or_path)
L00068:         tokenizer = AutoTokenizer.from_pretrained(model_name_or_path)
L00069:     elif model_type == 'codet5':
L00070:         model = T5ForConditionalGeneration.from_pretrained(model_name_or_path)
L00071:         tokenizer = RobertaTokenizer.from_pretrained(model_name_or_path)
L00072:     elif model_type == 'gpt2':
L00073:         model = GPT2LMHeadModel.from_pretrained(model_name_or_path)
L00074:         tokenizer = AutoTokenizer.from_pretrained(model_name_or_path)
L00075:     elif model_type == 'bart':
L00076:         model = BartModel.from_pretrained(model_name_or_path)
L00077:         tokenizer = BartTokenizer.from_pretrained(model_name_or_path)
L00078:     else:
L00079:         raise ValueError('model_type must be one of `gpt-neo`, `codet5`, `gpt2`, `bart`')
L00080: 
L00081:     pipe = pipeline('text-generation', model=model, tokenizer=tokenizer, device=0)
L00082:     print("load generation pipeline from {} over, vocab size = {}, eos id = {}.".format(model_name_or_path, len(tokenizer), tokenizer.eos_token_id))
L00083:     return pipe
L00084: 
L00085: def complete_code(pipe, prompt, max_length=64, num_completions=4, seed=1):
L00086:     set_seed(seed)
L00087: 
L00088:     if do_normalize:
L00089:         prompt = prompt.replace("    ", '\t')
L00090: 
L00091:     code_gens = pipe(prompt,
L00092:                     num_return_sequences=num_completions,
L00093:                     num_beams=4,
L00094:                     max_length=max_length,
L00095:                     no_repeat_ngram_size=8)
L00096: 
L00097:     code_strings = []
L00098:     for code_gen in code_gens:
L00099:         generated_code = extract_first_block(code_gen['generated_text'][len(prompt):])
L00100:         if do_normalize:
L00101:             generated_code = generated_code.replace('\t', '    ')
L00102:         code_strings.append(prompt + generated_code)
L00103: 
L00104:     print(('\n'+'='*80 + '\n').join(code_strings))
L00105:     print('\n' + '='*80)
L00106:     return code_strings
L00107: 
L00108: def run_human_eval(
L00109:     model_name_or_path: str, 
L00110:     output_dir: str="./output/",

L00120:

L00122:         output_dir = model_name_or_path

L00124:     print('Run evaluation for {}, model_type = {}.'.format(model_name, model_type))
L00125:     pipe: Pipeline = load_generation_pipe(model_name_or_path, model_type)
L00126: 
L00127:     problems = read_problems()
L00128:     samples = []
L00129:     generate_batch_size = min(50, num_samples_per_task)
L00130:     for task_id in tqdm(problems):
L00131:         for _ in range(num_samples_per_task // generate_batch_size):            
L00132:             gen_results = generate_code(pipe.model, pipe.tokenizer, problems[task_id]["prompt"], generate_batch_size)
L00133:             for gen_result in gen_results:
L00134:                 samples.append(dict(task_id=task_id, completion=gen_result))
L00135: 
L00136:     saved_path = os.path.join(output_dir, f"official_{library}_{user_name}_{model_type}_apinum_{str(api_number)}_temp_{temperature}.samples.jsonl")
L00137:     write_jsonl(saved_path, samples)
L00138: 
L00139:     print("Run prediction over, save to {}".format(saved_path))
L00140:     pass

L00045:     start_pos = 0
